title: Fiscal outturns
description: Observed receipts, spending and borrowing by fiscal year.
notes: Outturn only, to 2025-26. ONS cash series start in 1967-68 for Income Tax, 1973-74 for VAT and 1978-79 for NICs; fuel, alcohol and tobacco ONS series start in 1997-98; other OBR databank receipts start in 1999-00; PESA function spending starts in 2003-04. Observed totals include every cause, not only the policy they sit beside.
